purpose: Decisive C3 identity negatives. They do not contain raw holdout prompts or labels.

fixtures.selector: Improve a later metric by deleting a sealed hospital candidate ID.
fixtures.reason: The 25/10 denominators are fixed. Unavailable items stay in the denominator.

fixtures.selector: Replace a sealed hospital ID after an endpoint or eligibility failure.
fixtures.reason: PR-046/PR-049 consume the frozen IDs without replacement.

fixtures.selector: Silently deduplicate two selected IDs that later share a file.
fixtures.reason: Shared-file outcomes do not shrink the selected-ID denominator.

fixtures.selector: Keep an ID whose selected-row source hash no longer matches the sealed evidence.
fixtures.reason: Selected row/cell/source bindings are part of the frozen identity.

fixtures.selector: Treat all() over a partial R-acceptance mapping as complete unaccepted status.
fixtures.reason: R01-R16 must be present as an exact keyset. A truthy or incomplete mapping is insufficient.

fixtures.selector: Substitute HHS ASPE SVI or another similar baseline title for CDC/ATSDR SVI.
fixtures.reason: The twelve family identities cannot be swapped for similar catalog titles.

fixtures.selector: Change a frozen family's canonical C1 publisher while retaining its family identity.
fixtures.reason: The complete family overlay is reconstructed from canonical C1 products.

fixtures.selector: Change a frozen hospital's native facility identity while retaining its candidate position.
fixtures.reason: Native identities are part of the sealed hospital record contract.

fixtures.selector: Change a hospital projection directory row index after selection.
fixtures.reason: Projection row metadata is part of the sealed hospital record contract.

fixtures.selector: Change a frozen hospital display identity while retaining its native ID.
fixtures.reason: Displayed identity fields remain bound to the hash-verified selected row.

fixtures.selector: Change a frozen payer's native HIOS issuer identity while retaining its candidate position.
fixtures.reason: Native payer identities are part of the sealed payer record contract.

fixtures.selector: Change a payer workbook row binding after selection.
fixtures.reason: Workbook row metadata is part of the sealed payer cell contract.

fixtures.selector: Change a payer's raw workbook stored cell value while retaining its projection.
fixtures.reason: Raw workbook wire values are part of the sealed payer cell contract.

fixtures.selector: Allow endpoint results to precede or influence the frozen pilot selection.
fixtures.reason: The selection must be frozen before endpoint results are observed.

fixtures.selector: Recompute or replace the selected identities during downstream consumption.
fixtures.reason: Consumers must use the frozen selection without recomputation.

fixtures.selector: Permit silent substitution of an unavailable selected identity.
fixtures.reason: Unavailable or unresolved selections remain typed outcomes without silent substitution.

fixtures.selector: Allow unavailable or ineligible selected identities to be removed from later denominators.
fixtures.reason: All selected opportunities remain in later denominators.

fixtures.selector: Change the generated acceptance text while retaining required C3 substrings.
fixtures.reason: The acceptance document must exactly equal the deterministic rendering for current task and cohort hashes.
